notes.title: 0.76.70 Multiple Business Opportunities Update
notes.notes:
Are you looking to expand your business portfolio? Well, look no further we have 5 new exciting business opportunities to present to you. 

1 - The Warehouse.
Ever wanted to store lots of cash before moving it onto the next location? Well now you can for the reasonable price of $10m
The warehouse is great for players who want to have a central location for multiple money streams before moving onto a bank. Pair this with the laundromat for maximum illegal efficiency!

2 - Bank Branch
Want a bank to open closer to your profitable business streams? Unlock the ability to place a bank anywhere on the map for $10m.
The bank is a special card similar to the Laundromat and therefore won't be very common, consider grabbing a bank branch when you can during your runs.

3 - Starter Business
Everyone gets a starter business but have you yearned for more? Buy the Starter Business card for a low low price of $5m.
This is a great card to unlock if you're creating business streams that you don't want to add to, now you can start a new business stream from scratch without waiting to be gifted a starter business. Similar to the Bank Branch this is a special card.

4 - Bulldozer
Time to clear up that mess! If the rubble from failed and caught illegal activities are getting in the way of your perfect run then you need the Bulldozer card. For only $5m unlock the ability to clear all the destroyed businesses on the map and clear space for new ventures.
This card is essential if you want to use lots of illegal businesses and find them getting destroyed. This card is an action card that will perform an action once when played. 

5 - Relocate
Kicking yourself for placing a business in that spot? Found a more ideal location? Time to unlock the Relocate action card for only
 $5m. Once chosen players can move an already placed business to a new location, normal business placing rules will apply on when relocating. 

QOL & Bug fixes
Reduced and fixed the Quarterly difficulty targets
Multiple translation fixes (thankyou for pointing these out to us)
Made the business information window close more intuitively

notes.title: 0.70.48 Portfolio Update
notes.notes:
In the first significant Simple CEO update, we introduce a new feature and some QOL fixes. 

Build your business portfolio!
Unlock new cards in the portfolio found in the main menu. Spend your hard-earned cash on new business opportunities. These unlocked cards will show up during your playthrough and will offer unique effects or improved stats to help you reach the board's financial demands!

The Laundromat
The first new business opportunity to purchase for the low sum of $10m is the Laundromat. Are you struggling to find a place for the illegal buildings in your empire? Well, look no further. The laundromat will clean any illicit money that passes through and spit out clean money ready to be deposited into the bank. The laundromat can handle large amounts of cash but will take a small percentage of the funds to perform this valuable service. 

QOL & Bug fixes
Tutorial is now available from the settings menu at any time
Moved the settings menu to the top left of the home screen
Added portfolio button to the main menu
Added a new model for the starter businesses, the Lemonade Stall
Leaderboard improvements
Cleaned up some translations
Added more tooltips 
Fixed some UI issues when scaling to different resolutions

Thank you for trying out Simple CEO, we have lots of future business opportunities for you to invest in. Let us know what business you would like to see!
